preconditions.description: The length of string A is between 1 and 10^4.
The length of string B is between 1 and 10^4.
Both A and B are valid strings.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum number of steps required to transform A into B, or -1 if transformation is not possible.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 if any(char not in B for char in A) or len(A) != len(B)
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if A contains a character not in B or if A and B have different lengths.

postconditions.expression: output == count_transformations if transformation is possible
postconditions.description: The output is the number of transformations required if A can be transformed into B.
